subject.title: [Feature]: Feature Request: Batch Tool Calls + Context Block Management + Plan Enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw pursue any of these requested native core surfaces now: file/search batching, AI-callable context blocks, or runner-enforced submitted plans?
rationale: The request changes core tool schemas, context/session persistence semantics, config surface, and enforcement policy while VISION.md only partially aligns and warns against heavy orchestration layers or optional capability that can live through plugin/API seams.

options.title: Split for design review
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and ask maintainers to sponsor narrower design tracks for any surface they want to pursue.

options.title: Route pieces to plugins or existing seams
options.body: Defer core changes unless a plugin/API gap is proven, using existing Parallel Search, context-engine, and tool/plugin seams where adequate.

options.title: Decline the broad direction
options.body: Close only after a maintainer decides the combined native batching, context-block, and plan-enforcement direction is not planned for core.

recommendation.title: Split for design review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and ask maintainers to sponsor narrower design tracks for any surface they want to pursue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent history on update_plan, strict-agentic behavior, and the prior product-direction review for this item.
